roles.validation: CNRPark A later block; checkpoint, temperature and routing thresholds
roles.cnrpark_b: observed development comparison (viewed in the 2026-10-16 error audit); not a blind test
roles.cnr_ext: held-out: 9 new views of the same lot, 2015-11..2016-02, sunny/overcast/rainy; no model, threshold or default choice used it

default_model.rule: highest balanced accuracy on the observed CNRPark B development comparison; fixed before CNR-EXT scoring (protocol appendix 1)

source_digest.method: sha256 of sorted "id:source_sha256\n" lines over all EXT images
